## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-4008 by identifying that the ingress-nginx controller upgrade to v1.12.1 disabled snippet annotations (`allow-snippet-annotations=false`), which broke the legacy-portal's regex-based URL redirects. The controller logs explicitly showed the annotation being skipped. I provided the ticket owner with two actionable paths forward: either re-enable snippet annotations in the controller configuration or refactor the Ingress to use alternative redirect methods, recommending coordination with the platform team to align with security policies.
